item.tib: rtsa sgrub las chog kha tshar las tshe sgrub g.yung drung rang lugs
item.coloph: zhes tshe chog g.yung drung rang lugs 'di ni snod ldan rnams kyis bskul ba la brten nas/ khyung dkar ming 'thob hor sprang grub ming 'bod pas/ shing mo yos lor nang g.yas ru mkhar sna'i sgrub phug gnam sgo mun med mthong gsal du mkhan chen nyi ma'i dbang po'i zhabs brtan skabs su thol shar du bris pas bkra shis su gyur cig/
